sentences.text:

2. Heard Mr.G.Santosh Pawan, learned counsel for petitioner, Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.
3.
The petitioner is arrayed as accused No.10 in C.C.No.3111 of 2021 facing accusation under Sections 406 and 420 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that though the petitioner got a strong case even for quashment, as he is determined to see the process through, the insistence for his presence is causing severe difficulty in pursuing his profession.
Therefore, prayed for dispensing his personal appearance in the proceedings, unless presence in person is required and such direction would redress his grievance.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that there is no specific objection for the prayer,
however pleaded for a direction for appearance of the petitioner on the material stages in the proceedings.
6.

Having regard to the submissions, subject to the petitioner's appearance through his counsel on every adjournment and the petitioner's presence as and when directed by the Court, the in-person presence of the petitioner in the proceedings of the C.C.No.3111 of 2021 on the file of the XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad at Nampally, is dispensed with.

sentences.text: Additionally it is specified that any lapse in abiding the above conditions would render this order ineffective.
7. With this direction, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
